data.description: You breathe out a blast of energy. Creatures in the affected area take 1d6 points of energy damage per caster level (maximum of 12d6). A successful Reflex save results in half damage. The spell's effect and energy type depend on the type of dragon scale used: Black dragon: 60-foot line of acid.  Blue or bronze dragon: 60-foot line of electricity.  Green dragon: 30-foot cone of acid.  Gold or red dragon: 30-foot cone of fire.  Silver or white dragon: 30-foot cone of cold.  Brass dragon: 60-foot line of fire.  Copper dragon: 60-foot line of acid.

raw_tokens.value: Gives you a dragon's breath weapon.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
